steps.content: This darkness feels familiar.
So is the sensation. It feels as though a snake has wrapped itself around your neck, cold and suffocating.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Serpent...?!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Hehe... Take a guess! Is this a dream, or reality?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Or maybe... neither. Maybe we're in a realm of pain!
Serpent materializes by degrees in the darkness. She is on top of you, her greenish-gray eyes quivering.
A warm drop of liquid alights on the corner of your mouth. It glides into your mouth, and the tip of your tongue tastes something faintly salty. It's a teardrop, you realize.
Are you... crying?
The feeling of constriction around your neck intensifies. You have no time to reflect on what the teardrop represents, because you don't want to miss the window of opportunity.
There is a flash of red light, and a tangle of tendrils flows out of your palm and onto Serpent.
The second your psyche is connected to hers, countless cries of pain, sorrow, and hatred flood your consciousness.
The darkness recedes. Your ears start humming, but you know what just happened wasn't a hallucination, for Serpent is lying in your arms.

steps.speaker: Soldier
steps.content: Found Chief!! Medical team, hurry up!

steps.speaker: Soldier
steps.content: Chief, are you all right? Should we do anything about that Sinner?! She just whisked you away, like some kind of magic trick...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm okay. She passed out. I've used the shackles on her. But something is amiss with her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We're going back to the Bureau for now. Give her the best treatment. I need to talk to her as soon as possible.

steps.speaker: Soldier
steps.content: Yes, Chief!
It has been ten days since the Ambrosia incident. You have been searching for Serpent, hoping to prevent a recurrence of the incident.
But locating a masterfully-camouflaged snake in the forest is no easy task. Besides, nothing untoward has happened in these ten days.
It could be the lull before the storm, however. Serpent is still at large. You can't feel at ease, nor can you let your guard down, because she could be waiting for a chance to fight back.
Then in your most recent operation, she, much to your surprise, gave herself up.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Ow, the light is harsh...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Is this how the MBCC treats someone who just came to?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Oh, I get it... I don't deserve to be treated nicely, because you don't think of Sinners as human beings, right?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We didn't mean to make you feel that way.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You've just woken up, and now you have to stay in an interrogation room. This is hard on you, I know. But... there is a ton of unfinished business we have to deal with now.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Yes, yes... a ton of business, some out in the open, some hidden in the dark...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Chief, you're very busy indeed. Haha.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll cut to the chase. Where is the Bottle of Dreams now?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Why does it matter? No matter where it is, now... I am in your hands.
Serpent blinks at you. Her voice is saccharine.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: As the Chief of MBCC, I have to be cautious.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: After all... experience has taught me that Sinners who're willing to give themselves up tend to be more dangerous.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: It seems you've been through a lot, Chief... How about giving Ambrosia another go? It might just help you let go of those painful memories.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Oops, I almost forgot...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Ambrosia can't bring you happiness.
Serpent tilts her head, and gives you a smile that reveals her pointed canine teeth.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: But that doesn't matter. Happiness... Happiness is something that can be made.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You know how happiness is made, right? You've seen it; you've been there.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Making happiness... Are you still so hung up on Ambrosia?
Serpent twirls a stray lock of hair around her finger, studying your eyes as if in admiration. It's some time before she speaks again.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You've eliminated Marv already... Why are you still worried about Ambrosia?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What I'm worried about is the Bottle of Dreams you took.

options: Ask about the source of the original Ambrosia

choices.text: Ask about the source of the original Ambrosia

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You told me it's Marv that created the original Ambrosia and used it to bewitch humans before sucking their life force dry to turn them into Corruptors. Marv was nothing like those Mania-turned monsters in the FAC records; it's powerful and elusive.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Your point?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You said you came upon it by accident... Can you tell me more? When and where did you come upon it? And where did it come from?
Serpent doesn't seem eager to answer your questions. She looks away to stare at the clock on the wall, beating time to the passing of each second.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I don't remember, and... I don't think it's important.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You don't remember, or it didn't happen at all?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: What do you mean?

At first, the MBCC found nothing useful when it went through the files on the Sinners. Then, thanks to a thorough investigation conducted by the 9th Agency, you found something worth noticing about her identity.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I have reason to believe that... you created Ambrosia and the monster with your power.
Serpent takes a sideways glance at the files on the table without turning around to look at you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A few years ago, pet snakes were all the rage in Eastside, and a girl who could speak to snakes was the talk of the town for some time on social media.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Shortly afterward, an accident happened: a pet snake attacked its owner. It prompted the introduction of a bill in Eastside prohibiting its citizens from keeping large snakes as pets; and those who do, do so at their own peril.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The Public Security Bureau still hasn't found that pet owner, and in the end, they gave a verdict of "death due to mistakes made in raising of a pet snake."

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You were the girl who could speak to snakes, weren't you? And you spoke to the snake of that victimized family.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: What if I was? I was no longer there when they were bathed in intoxicating happiness.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I know that.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I discovered through my investigation that the family did get their pet through some illegitimate channel. I followed up the lead and found something amiss.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Other than number, weight, activeness level, there's an additional item of information on their purchase record.
You point at the handwritten information on the photo.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Foodstuffs. It didn't specify the type of food or the weight. Simply alive.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Yes, it meant me.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: That's why you think I was the perpetrator?
Serpent looks at you, her lips set in a pout of annoyance.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: They played with fire and got burned. And you're blaming me. Be reasonable, Chief.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Anyway, they signed me over to an entertainment company, which, in a way, freed me from the hellhole.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Hmph. I was happy with my life, why would I get myself tangled up with them anymore.
The smirk on Serpent's face lingers; she seems certain that you can't do anything about her.

The first case was closed as the police couldn't find anything suspicious. At the time of the incident, Serpent was already an employee of **** Entertainment. How could she have had anything to do with the case?
Seems like she is not going to be honest with you. Looking her in the eye, you decide to change the subject.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: All right. Let's talk about something else.

choices.text: All right. Let's talk about something else.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Let's talk about the entertainment company you just mentioned.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: What's there to talk about? There's nothing illegal about them signing me. The family... got me a temporary ID card.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's not what I want to talk about.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your performance with snakes was a huge hit. You became quite a celebrity on Eastside's underground novelty-show scene, and you were often hired to perform at various venues.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You brought in handsome revenues for the company. That's why they covered up your involvement in the incident.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Yeah, right! Like that shitty company would do something like that for me; they wouldn't even give me a bigger cut.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Like the victims in the pet snake case, all those people involved in this case vanished without a trace. Plus the entertainment company tried very hard to suppress the news. So in the end, the case was shelved.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Of course, the authority given to us has allowed us to learn more about these two cases.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: For example, both in the pet snake case and in the entertainment company case, the scenes had been trashed, turned completely upside down.
It looked like the work of some extraordinary monsters... Corruptors, I suppose.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ever since then, you have been using Ambrosia to... to torture them, am I right?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: What if I have? Like I said, I was creating happiness! I am helping them build sweet dreams!!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: So what if they end up vomiting up black sludge, end up turning into Corruptors? Those painful memories are supposed to be discarded! Why... why are you resisting Ambrosia?! I want the happiness, the sweet dreams of you all!!
Serpent spits out her words like venom. She huffs and puffs, her shoulders heaving, as if saying those words were a great effort for her.
You've known a thing or two about Serpent's obsession with happiness. But in District 14, when she stirred things up, she was not as uncontrollable or hysterical as she is now.
The shackles are throbbing like crazy. Dimly, you sense Serpent's feelings. Her life force seems to be in the grip of some mysterious entity, making her go berserk.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You... You wouldn't understand their happiness, let alone their pain.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You don't understand their pain either... You simply ignored it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Indulging yourself with sweet dreams can't fix everything, Serpent.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I once met a Sinner who lost herself in an amusement park of her own. I don't know if I helped her, but such excessive indulgence brought her only pain.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I don't want you to suffer the same fate.
You rise to your feet, walk around the table to stand in front of Serpent, and look her in the eye.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: How can you be so sure that it will cause me pain?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You can't experience happiness or have sweet dreams, and here you are, sitting on your high horse criticizing me?
Serpent lifts her head, staring at you like a kid hoping for an answer to a question just asked.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm not criticizing you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The sleepwalkers' symptoms have been worsening since day one, and Ambrosia is getting more potent. If you don't keep your power and the Bottle of Dreams in check, you'll suffer even more...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Stop losing yourself in the Realm of Dreams. Stop using Ambrosia. Serpent, could you please tell me where the Bottle of Dreams is?
Serpent falls silent, so does the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's dangerous to indulge in those sweet dreams that can't bring you true happiness.
Serpent remains silent. You continue persuading her, to no avail.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: My happiness, my dreams... Chief, you asked me why I came back.
Serpent trailed off, and when she speaks again after a long pause, her voice is as cold as ice.
You feel cold on the nape of your neck. A small snake has found its way there without you knowing it, and it is hissing in your ear.
Serpent looks up at you from her seat, a chill in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ambrosia doesn't work on me.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I know.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I just want to make good on my promise. In the last minute, I want to give you happiness. So, now I'm going to present to you... a grand circus show.
Serpent leans forward ever so slightly, whispering to you in a hypnotizing tone.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Chief... Would you give me your hands?
You raise your hands, which Serpent takes in hers gently and brings close to her lips. Her palms are as cold as the snake around your neck.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Good... Aren't you afraid that I might do something, Chief?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Surely you can sense that the shackles are already on you.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Hehe... Yes, I can.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Which means... you are at my mercy. If anyone should worry, it should be you.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Aren't you confident that you won't get lost in the Realm of Dreams? Take another gamble with me then. You do everything you can to break and untangle the mess to find the answer, and I... I will risk everything I have to give you happiness.
You could use the shackles to force her to tell you who gave her Ambrosia and where the Bottle of Dreams is. But that wouldn't solve the problem at its source.

You are not concerned about or afraid of what she's going to do to you. For one thing is sure: you must shatter her twisted obsession with happiness and sweet dreams, much the way you must shatter the Realm of Dreams.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Okay then, take me to the show.
Looking at her pointed canine teeth, you give her a faint smile.
The shackles tremble, and your psyche and Serpent's respond in sync. It's as if you're laying everything bare for each other to see, but at the same time, hiding everything from each other.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Fantastic! My beloved Chief, my beloved audience...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Let's go enjoy the merriest, grandest circus show!
The announcement is followed by a gentle kiss on your fingertip.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ow!
You feel a sudden stab of pain in your fingertip, and look down. A scarlet blob is blossoming.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Really sorry, Chief.
Serpent doesn't let go of your hands. Instead, she tightens her grip and bends down to kiss your fingertip for a long second.
Your vision blurs, and you feel something moving up from your fingertip where it has been punctured. You start feeling lethargic.
You have a vague feeling that you are still in the interrogation room. And then a white mist rises around you; you give yourself over to that lethargic feeling, sinking deeper and deeper...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: <color=#e45515>The awake one does not enter the Realm of Dreams... Come in to my story then.</color>
